sql: select 'order' k, market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity v, status, created_at::text t from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-09-30 06:07' or status='resting') union all select 'fill', market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||price||'x'||quantity, '', filled_at::text from fills where filled_at > '2026-09-30 06:07' and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1') union all select 'now', '', '', '', now()::text order by t desc limit 60
